copy:
Delight in an evening dining package at Tomorrowland Skyline Terrace with iconic chilled foods, snacks and desserts, inspired by the heyday of the Space Age. Plus, take in views of a stunning nighttime spectacular!

This experience is available from 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM with the same flexibility to stay all evening or come and go at your leisure. Each person in your party must purchase a dining package to enter.

Stunning Views
Fireworks light up the sky on select nights and, from your vantage point, you'll see lots of dazzling bursts—though keep in mind, projections won’t be visible from this location. For the latest on which spectacular show awaits you, check the entertainment schedule or Disneyland app before you arrive. Discover the magic and thrill of every fireworks display at Disneyland Park.

All fireworks at Disneyland Park are dependent on weather conditions and subject to change or cancellation.

Menu options may include:

Adults
  • Meats, cheeses and crackers
  • Seasonal fruits
  • Seasonal desserts
  • Unlimited soft drinks, bottled water, coffee, hot tea or hot chocolate
  • Specialty-themed nonalcoholic beverage
Kids
  • Cold seasonal sandwich
  • Rolled bananas
  • Seasonal vegetables with dipping sauce
  • Cheese ball and crackers
  • Seasonal desserts
  • Unlimited soft drinks, bottled water, coffee, hot tea or hot chocolate
  • Specialty-themed nonalcoholic beverage

After checking in, you’ll be escorted to Skyline Terrace and can pick up your meal and beverages.

Price
$75 per Guest

Price does not include theme park admission and park reservation which are required on the same day of the dining package reservation for each Guest aged 3 and older.

Full payment is due at the time of booking. Discounts do not apply. Tax is not included. Gratuity is not included or required. Children ages 2 and younger may attend free of charge, provided they are seated on the lap of an adult.

Reservations
Make advance dining reservations on this page or via the Disneyland app. Same-day reservations can be made on a limited basis and are subject to availability.

  • Reserve an arrival time between 7:30 PM and 8:00 PM.
  • Guests who have purchased this dining package will be granted admission to the Tomorrowland Skyline Terrace balcony from 7:30 PM until 10:00 PM.

items.title: Theme Park Reservation and Admission Required
items.content: A separate theme park reservation and valid admission for Disneyland Park on the same date is required for each Guest ages 3 and older, and is not included in the dining package price.

items.title: Reservations
items.content:
Advance reservations are highly recommended and can be made on this page or with the Disneyland app up to 60 days before your visit.


Same-day reservations can be made on a limited basis and are subject to availability. Full payment is due upon booking.

items.title: Special Dietary Requests
items.content:
We use reasonable efforts in our food preparation and handling procedures to avoid the introduction of the most common allergens into your menu choices. While we take steps to prevent cross-contact, we do not have separate allergy-friendly kitchens and are unable to guarantee that a menu item is completely free of allergens. Additionally, allergy-friendly offerings are reliant on supplier ingredient labels, and we cannot guarantee the accuracy of the contents of each food item. Allergen advisory statements (e.g., “may contain”) are not regulated and therefore not taken into consideration when developing allergy-friendly meals. It is ultimately up to your discretion to make an informed choice based upon your individual dietary needs.

 

Once seated, please inform your server if you have an allergy request—even if you previously indicated it during the reservation process. This will help ensure our special diets processes can be followed when preparing your meal.

 

When booking your reservation online or via the Disneyland app, look for the prompt to add any special dietary or allergy-friendly requests. Please note we cannot guarantee accommodations for day-of requests.

items.title: Checking In
items.content: At your reservation time, check in with a host at the Tomorrowland Skyline Podium near Alien Pizza Planet. After checking in, Guests will be escorted to Skyline Terrace where they will be able to pick up their meal and beverages.

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content:
This restaurant has a cancellation policy. The credit card provided at the time of reservation will automatically be charged a per-person fee if you don’t show up for your reservation or fail to cancel in accordance with the policy. Policy details will be available when you make your reservation and in your confirmation email.

Cancellations and modifications to reservations can be made by visiting My Dining and Activity Reservations or via the Disneyland app by tapping "My Plans."

items.title: Strollers
items.content: For the safety of our Guests, strollers are not permitted in the balcony area and must remain on the ground level.

items.title: Additional Information
items.content:
Menu items, pricing, hours and any applicable entertainment offerings are subject to change or cancellation without notice.

The Tomorrowland Skyline Terrace Dining Package may not be refunded, redeemed for cash, sold or exchanged for different dates or times.

items.title: Show Cancellation
items.content: Performances can be cancelled without notice due to technical, weather or other issues. No refunds or exchanges will be available, even if the show is cancelled.

items.title: Showtimes
items.content: Fireworks occur on select nights only. Guests will have a view of the fireworks but not of projections that take place during the show. Please check our Entertainment Schedule or the Disneyland app for dates and availability.

items.title: Seating
items.content:
Parties of up to 8 can be accommodated. Seating is shared; Guests may be seated with other parties. Keep in mind, upon your arrival, all members of your party must be present before being seated, and hosts must bring your entire party to the table at one time.


This experience offers both indoor and outdoor seating; seating preference is not guaranteed. Guests will have access to the balcony for taking in the view.

items.title: Children
items.content: All children must be accompanied by an adult 18 years of age or older for the duration of the dining and viewing experience.

items.title: Credential Information
items.content: Each person in the party must purchase a dining package to obtain a credential, and will receive the credential upon check-in. One credential for the reserved viewing area will be issued for each Tomorrowland Skyline Terrace Dining Package purchased. Credentials are only valid for the date purchased.

importantMessage.title: An Important Message
importantMessage.content: In-park dining requires a theme park reservation and valid admission for the same park on the same date for each Guest ages 3 and older. Learn more about available dining options at the Disneyland Resort.
